1→use safe_arith::SafeArith;
     2→use std::mem;
     3→use types::{
     4→    BeaconState, BeaconStateError as Error, BeaconStateFulu, ChainSpec, EthSpec, Fork, Vector,
     5→};
     6→
     7→/// Transform a `Electra` state into an `Fulu` state.
     8→pub fn upgrade_to_fulu<E: EthSpec>(
     9→    pre_state: &mut BeaconState<E>,
    10→    spec: &ChainSpec,
    11→) -> Result<(), Error> {
    12→    let _epoch = pre_state.current_epoch();
    13→
    14→    let post = upgrade_state_to_fulu(pre_state, spec)?;
    15→
    16→    *pre_state = post;
    17→
    18→    Ok(())
    19→}
    20→
    21→fn initialize_proposer_lookahead<E: EthSpec>(
    22→    state: &BeaconState<E>,
    23→    spec: &ChainSpec,
    24→) -> Result<Vector<u64, E::ProposerLookaheadSlots>, Error> {
    25→    let current_epoch = state.current_epoch();
    26→    let mut lookahead = Vec::with_capacity(E::proposer_lookahead_slots());
    27→    for i in 0..(spec.min_seed_lookahead.safe_add(1)?.as_u64()) {
    28→        let target_epoch = current_epoch.safe_add(i)?;
    29→        lookahead.extend(
    30→            state
    31→                .get_beacon_proposer_indices(target_epoch, spec)
    32→                .map(|vec| vec.into_iter().map(|x| x as u64))?,
    33→        );
    34→    }
    35→
    36→    Vector::new(lookahead).map_err(|e| {
    37→        Error::PleaseNotifyTheDevs(format!("Failed to initialize proposer lookahead: {:?}", e))
    38→    })
    39→}
    40→
    41→pub fn upgrade_state_to_fulu<E: EthSpec>(
    42→    pre_state: &mut BeaconState<E>,
    43→    spec: &ChainSpec,
    44→) -> Result<BeaconState<E>, Error> {
    45→    let epoch = pre_state.current_epoch();
    46→    let proposer_lookahead = initialize_proposer_lookahead(pre_state, spec)?;
    47→    let pre = pre_state.as_electra_mut()?;
    48→    // Where possible, use something like `mem::take` to move fields from behind the &mut
    49→    // reference. For other fields that don't have a good default value, use `clone`.
    50→    //
    51→    // Fixed size vectors get cloned because replacing them would require the same size
    52→    // allocation as cloning.
    53→    let post = BeaconState::Fulu(BeaconStateFulu {
    54→        // Versioning
    55→        genesis_time: pre.genesis_time,
    56→        genesis_validators_root: pre.genesis_validators_root,
    57→        slot: pre.slot,
    58→        fork: Fork {
    59→            previous_version: pre.fork.current_version,
    60→            current_version: spec.fulu_fork_version,
    61→            epoch,
    62→        },
    63→        // History
    64→        latest_block_header: pre.latest_block_header.clone(),
    65→        block_roots: pre.block_roots.clone(),
    66→        state_roots: pre.state_roots.clone(),
    67→        historical_roots: mem::take(&mut pre.historical_roots),
    68→        // Eth1
    69→        eth1_data: pre.eth1_data.clone(),
    70→        eth1_data_votes: mem::take(&mut pre.eth1_data_votes),
    71→        eth1_deposit_index: pre.eth1_deposit_index,
    72→        // Registry
    73→        validators: mem::take(&mut pre.validators),
    74→        balances: mem::take(&mut pre.balances),
    75→        // Randomness
    76→        randao_mixes: pre.randao_mixes.clone(),
    77→        // Slashings
    78→        slashings: pre.slashings.clone(),
    79→        // `Participation
    80→        previous_epoch_participation: mem::take(&mut pre.previous_epoch_participation),
    81→        current_epoch_participation: mem::take(&mut pre.current_epoch_participation),
    82→        // Finality
    83→        justification_bits: pre.justification_bits.clone(),
    84→        previous_justified_checkpoint: pre.previous_justified_checkpoint,
    85→        current_justified_checkpoint: pre.current_justified_checkpoint,
    86→        finalized_checkpoint: pre.finalized_checkpoint,
    87→        // Inactivity
    88→        inactivity_scores: mem::take(&mut pre.inactivity_scores),
    89→        // Sync committees
    90→        current_sync_committee: pre.current_sync_committee.clone(),
    91→        next_sync_committee: pre.next_sync_committee.clone(),
    92→        // Execution
    93→        latest_execution_payload_header: pre.latest_execution_payload_header.upgrade_to_fulu(),
    94→        // Capella
    95→        next_withdrawal_index: pre.next_withdrawal_index,
    96→        next_withdrawal_validator_index: pre.next_withdrawal_validator_index,
    97→        historical_summaries: pre.historical_summaries.clone(),
    98→        // Electra
    99→        deposit_requests_start_index: pre.deposit_requests_start_index,
   100→        deposit_balance_to_consume: pre.deposit_balance_to_consume,
   101→        exit_balance_to_consume: pre.exit_balance_to_consume,
   102→        earliest_exit_epoch: pre.earliest_exit_epoch,
   103→        consolidation_balance_to_consume: pre.consolidation_balance_to_consume,
   104→        earliest_consolidation_epoch: pre.earliest_consolidation_epoch,
   105→        pending_deposits: pre.pending_deposits.clone(),
   106→        pending_partial_withdrawals: pre.pending_partial_withdrawals.clone(),
   107→        pending_consolidations: pre.pending_consolidations.clone(),
   108→        // Caches
   109→        total_active_balance: pre.total_active_balance,
   110→        progressive_balances_cache: mem::take(&mut pre.progressive_balances_cache),
   111→        committee_caches: mem::take(&mut pre.committee_caches),
   112→        pubkey_cache: mem::take(&mut pre.pubkey_cache),
   113→        exit_cache: mem::take(&mut pre.exit_cache),
   114→        slashings_cache: mem::take(&mut pre.slashings_cache),
   115→        epoch_cache: mem::take(&mut pre.epoch_cache),
   116→        proposer_lookahead,
   117→    });
   118→    Ok(post)
   119→}
